items.title: AI Engineer
items.content_html:
Sumsub is the first AI-powered trust infrastructure for compliance operations at scale. It connects identity and business verification, fraud prevention, transaction monitoring, and risk workflows, helping teams reduce manual work and enter new markets.

Trusted by over 4,000 clients across financial services, crypto, mobility, trading, marketplaces, education, and iGaming, including Bybit, Bitpanda, Wirex, Avis, Vodafone, Duolingo, and Kaizen Gaming.

Sumsub is recognized as a Great Place To Work® in the US and rated 4.5 out of 5 on Glassdoor. Our 1,000+ people around the world back it up, too: 92% are proud to be Sumsubers, and 90% say their work is interesting and challenging.

Now we are looking for a AI Engineer (LLM focus) to build and scale the core intelligence behind Summy AI Copilot, our agentic assistant for compliance officers. This is an exciting opportunity to own a cutting-edge GenAI product, pushing LLMs beyond basic text generation to execute complex reasoning, and autonomous tasks.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Drive Summy AI Copilot: Own the core intelligence behind our AI assistant for compliance officers, taking features from concept to production rollout and operation.

  • Agentic Orchestration: Design and build robust, multi-turn AI agents (using frameworks like LangGraph) capable of complex reasoning, context retention, and autonomous action.

  • LLM Observability & Evaluation: Set up comprehensive tracing, monitoring (e.g., LangFuse), and evaluation pipelines (LLM-as-a-judge) to track quality, latency, and token cost.

  • Agentic Experience: Evolve our public MCP server and Agent Skills so that external AI agents (Claude, ChatGPT, etc) can work with Sumsub reliably and securely.

  • Pragmatic Iteration: Start with elementary, solid baselines and iteratively scale complexity based on real-world production metrics and A/B tests.

About You:

  • Experience: 5+ years in Software/Data/ML Engineering, with 1+ years explicitly focused on building and shipping production-grade GenAI/LLM systems.

  • In-Depth LLM Knowledge: You understand how LLMs work under the hood. You know how to push models far beyond basic text generation (e.g., structured extraction, tool calling, cost-aware routing).

  • LLM Stack Mastery: Hands-on experience with agentic orchestration (LangChain/LangGraph) and modern LLM APIs (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI).

  • Engineering Excellence: You write production-ready code for microservices (Java/Dropwizard), with experience in cloud deployments (GCP/AWS, Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Ownership: You own the system from early talks with customers to operating it in production.

Nice to have

  • Background in classical NLP, traditional MLOps, or large-scale data engineering.

  • Familiarity with compliance, anti-fraud, KYC/AML, or fintech domains.

  • Experience shipping production RAG systems.

What We Offer:

  • Remote-first, trust-based culture. Work from the place that works best for you. No mandatory office days, no attendance trackers. In some locations, we provide offices or coworking spaces, but the choice is yours.

  • True flexibility. We do not fix you to a 9-to-5 schedule. You can adjust your working hours when needed, as long as your day stays productive and in sync with the team.

  • Extra time off. Your birthday is a holiday here. Add to that 10 personal days each year, seven sick days without paperwork, and extra time to enjoy Christmas and New Year. Time to rest is part of the deal.

  • Work that matters. Our mission is to build a digital world that is secure, accessible and inclusive for everyone. From fighting fraud to making online services easier and safer to use, your work will have a real impact on how people experience trust online.

  • Compensation. We offer fair and transparent pay, benchmarked to the market.

  • Truly global. We work across continents and time zones, with teammates and customers from all over the world. You will run campaigns that cross borders, cultures, and languages, and see your ideas land worldwide.

  • Growth built in. Clear goals, open feedback and personal development plans. We support your progress with learning opportunities and by covering role-specific events, from design conferences to marketing forums.

  • Celebrating your big moments. We are proud to support you through life’s biggest journeys with dedicated financial bonuses for both marriage and welcoming a new baby to your family.

  • Team offsites. Sometimes just Slack is not enough. That is why we meet in person a few times a year. Trips are fully covered, so you can meet, collaborate, and recharge together.

  • Getting you set up. We make sure you have access to the tools and hardware you need to do your work well.

  • Friendly by design. Our logo is a dog for a reason. We keep things human, open and kind. We welcome individuality, quirks and different perspectives, because that is what makes our work smarter and more fun.

The hiring stages: TA screening -> Hiring Manager Interview -> Technical Interview -> Final Interview.

Sounds like a great opportunity for your career development? Then go ahead and apply!

We are a global community of innovators, creators, and thinkers, and we believe that diversity fuels our innovation. Sumsub is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, genders, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Join us in shaping the future inclusively.

We believe in fair and transparent compensation. Salaries vary depending on work location and applicable local market conditions.

This role is open to candidates in multiple countries, and compensation differs based on the candidate’s confirmed work location. For this reason, a single universal salary range is not included in this job posting.
The applicable work location will be confirmed early in the recruitment process, and the relevant compensation information for that location will be shared in writing, in line with local requirements.

items.title: NetSuite Business Analyst
items.content_html:

Sumsub is recognized as a Great Place To Work® in the US and rated 4.5 out of 5 on Glassdoor. Our 1,000+ people around the world back it up, too: 92% are proud to be Sumsubers, and 90% say their work is interesting and challenging.

We’re looking for a NetSuite Administrator to manage day-to-day configuration and turn Finance team requests into clear requirements and system improvements. The role combines hands-on administration, business analysis and coordination with developers.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Gather requirements from Finance, define acceptance criteria and write clear specifications, identifying what can be configured and what needs development.

  • Manage the Jira backlog and coordinate delivery with developers, agreeing priorities with your manager.

  • Configure custom fields, records, forms and SuiteFlow workflows; build saved searches, reports and dashboards.

  • Manage users, roles and permissions across subsidiaries, supporting segregation of duties and audit readiness.

  • Handle CSV imports and mass updates, maintaining data integrity and master data quality.

  • Build and edit Advanced PDF/HTML templates for invoices, credit memos and statements.

  • Test customizations, integrations and NetSuite releases in Sandbox, coordinate UAT with Finance, and validate financial transactions and GL impact.

  • Support users, troubleshoot issues, document changes and write short user guides.

About You:

  • Have experience administering ERP, CRM or other business systems, such as NetSuite, Salesforce, Dynamics or Odoo.

  • Are comfortable configuring fields, forms, reports and workflows.

  • Understand data models, record relationships and reference data.

  • Can clarify stakeholder requests and write clear technical specifications. Please bring an example to the interview.

  • Have basic HTML/CSS skills and feel comfortable editing templates, including using AI tools to write and review code.

  • Have English at B2 level or above and a careful approach to testing and documentation.

Nice to Have:

  • NetSuite experience or certification.

  • Familiarity with JavaScript, SQL or integrations.

  • Experience in business analysis, systems analysis or project coordination.

What We Offer:

  • Growth built in. Clear goals, open feedback and personal development plans. We support your progress with learning opportunities and by covering role-specific events, from design conferences to marketing forums.

items.title: Accountant & Financial Operations Specialist
items.content_html:
Sumsub is the first AI-powered trust infrastructure for compliance operations at scale. It connects identity and business verification, fraud prevention, transaction monitoring, and risk workflows, helping teams reduce manual work and enter new markets.

Trusted by over 4,000 clients across financial services, crypto, mobility, trading, marketplaces, education, and iGaming, including Bybit, Bitpanda, Wirex, Avis, Vodafone, Duolingo, and Kaizen Gaming.

Sumsub is recognized as a Great Place To Work® in the US and rated 4.5 out of 5 on Glassdoor. Our 1,000+ people around the world back it up, too: 92% are proud to be Sumsubers, and 90% say their work is interesting and challenging.

We’re looking for an Accountant & Financial Operations Specialist to support day-to-day accounting, maintain accurate financial records, and improve business operations through better workflows and automation. You’ll also help deliver a timely month-end close across Sumsub’s international entities.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Review and record client invoices, checking supporting documents, approvals, and account coding.

  • Reconcile bank accounts, client balances, and general ledger accounts, investigating and resolving discrepancies.

  • Support the month-end close, including journal entries, accruals, third-party payments, and bad debt provisions.

  • Communicate directly with clients and work with CSM, Sales Operations, Billing and Legal teams to obtain missing information and documentation.

  • Prepare schedules and supporting documents for reporting and audits, working with colleagues and external auditors.

  • Manage your own improvement initiatives from identifying an opportunity to implementing a solution.

  • Work closely with the automation team, providing clear requirements and helping automate accounting workflows, reconciliation templates, and other operational processes.

About You:

  • You have practical accounting or financial manager experience, including transaction posting, reconciliations, and month-end close.

  • You understand double-entry bookkeeping, accruals, prepayments, and financial statements.

  • You’ve worked with accounting software or ERP systems such as NetSuite, Oracle, or SAP.

  • You’re confident using Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, lookups, and pivot tables.

  • You’re accurate, organised, and comfortable working to deadlines.

  • You have good written and spoken English.

  • You take initiative, solve problems, and look for ways to make processes more efficient.

  • You’re interested in using AI and automation to improve day-to-day work.

  • Experience in an international or SaaS/fintech company, or with multiple entities or currencies, is a plus.

  • Experience at a Big Four firm is a plus.

What We Offer:

  • Remote-first, trust-based culture. Work from the place that works best for you. No mandatory office days, no attendance trackers. In some locations, we provide offices or coworking spaces, but the choice is yours.

  • True flexibility. We do not fix you to a 9-to-5 schedule. You can adjust your working hours when needed, as long as your day stays productive and in sync with the team.

  • Extra time off. Your birthday is a holiday here. Add to that 10 personal days each year, seven sick days without paperwork, and extra time to enjoy Christmas and New Year. Time to rest is part of the deal.

  • Work that matters. Our mission is to build a digital world that is secure, accessible and inclusive for everyone. From fighting fraud to making online services easier and safer to use, your work will have a real impact on how people experience trust online.

  • Compensation. We offer fair and transparent pay, benchmarked to the market.

  • Truly global. We work across continents and time zones, with teammates and customers from all over the world. You will run campaigns that cross borders, cultures, and languages, and see your ideas land worldwide.

  • Growth built in. Clear goals, open feedback and personal development plans. We support your progress with learning opportunities and by covering role-specific events, from design conferences to marketing forums.

  • Celebrating your big moments. We are proud to support you through life’s biggest journeys with dedicated financial bonuses for both marriage and welcoming a new baby to your family.

  • Team offsites. Sometimes just Slack is not enough. That is why we meet in person a few times a year. Trips are fully covered, so you can meet, collaborate, and recharge together.

  • Getting you set up. We make sure you have access to the tools and hardware you need to do your work well.
